newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria, Greece exchange ratified water pact.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria, Greece exchange ratified water pact.

text.p: Bulgaria and Greece on Thursday exchanged accords on the use of strategic water reserves, ending a decades-old dispute between the two Balkan neighbours.
Bulgaria's Foreign Minister Georgi Pirinski and his Greek counterpart Theodoros Pangalos met at the Bulgarian town of Smoljian, next to the Greek border.
They exchanged the pacts ratified by the parliaments of the two countries on joint use of the waters of the Mesta River, flowing through the two countries and on opening three new border checkpoints.
Under the accord Bulgaria will guarantee 29 percent of an average annual natural flow of 1.5 million cubic metres (53 million cu ft) to Greece.
Three new border checkpoints will start operating by end-1998.
